span.p:
Model Router
Rule: If query is simple (classification, translation, extraction) → route to GPT-3.5 (fast, cheap)
Rule: If query requires reasoning (math, code, analysis) → route to GPT-4 / GPT-4o (slow, expensive)
Rule: If user is free tier → route to GPT-3.5-mini
Rule: If user is enterprise → route to dedicated GPT-4 instance
